class.name: GameplayEffectStackPolicy
class.brief_description: Deterministic Gameplay Effect stacking, overflow and reapplication policies.
class.description: A reusable, stateless Gameplay Ability System-inspired policy for previewing effect applications. An instance holds a bounded multiplier table and policies, not live effects or timers. [method preview_application] receives the authoritative previous stack count and remaining seconds and returns an application decision without mutating the world. Duration factors are selected by prior stack count, holding the last factor for subsequent applications. Maximum 32 stacks and seven-day durations; all inputs must be finite. A server remains responsible for effect ownership, tick, damage, and replication.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets up this policy atomically. At most 32 stacks; factors may be zero to eight, finite and nonempty. A shorter factor table repeats its last element.

method.name: calculate_magnitude
method.description: Returns the bounded effect duration after stack and target modifiers, or zero for invalid input. This method ignores overflow policy and clamps the multiplier-table index.

method.name: preview_application
method.description: Returns a decision dictionary containing accepted, stacks, remaining, applied_duration, overflow, reason. Rejected application preserves the prior stack count and remaining time. Overflow policies clamp, reject or restart a stack cycle; reapplication policies can replace only when stronger, refresh, extend or keep the existing effect.

method.name: get_config
method.description: Returns an independent snapshot with max_stacks, stack_factors, overflow_policy, and reapply_policy.

method.name: replace_config
method.description: Transactionally restores configuration after strict type and range validation; invalid input never changes the previous policy.

method.name: get_max_stacks
method.description: Maximum stacks for the configured policy.

constants.constant: Continue refresh attempts while capping the stack count.
Reject further applications when the stack cap is reached.
Restart from stack one after reaching the cap.
Replace only if the new duration is longer than the current remaining duration.
Always refresh the remaining duration with the new duration.
Add the duration to the current remaining time, bounded by seven days.
Retain a currently active effect and reject its reapplication.
